notes.title: Major Bug Fix - Gemima or Jules getting permanently stuck
notes.notes:
A recent fix for inconsistent physics behaviour introduced a bug where Gemima or Jules could get permanently stuck when following the other at a very specific distance. 

Apologies if this affected your play!

notes.title: Hotfix to previous update
notes.notes: Includes the fix to "IT LOOKS A BIT LIKE A DOG, DUNNIT?" that removes an unintended shortcut, and turned off the no-use-to-anyone-else developmernt mode that sends you to a black screen after two seconds of the title screen. Sigh.

notes.title: Bug Fix: Missing cursor on Steam Deck on DLC select screen
notes.notes: This is what happens when you have to rush out a fix halfway through making DLC for a game...

notes.title: Bug Fix for Comma Based Cultures
notes.notes: A couple of decimal point values sneaked through and stopped the game reaching the first level in cultures with comma-based floating point values. Fixed!

notes.title: Update: Multiple Save Slots!
notes.notes:
By sort-of-popular request, Gemima now offers three save slots so you can try out the different modes without losing progress.

The previous main menu items of "Continue Game (mode)" and "Start New Game" have been replaced with a single "Play" menu item which takes you to the new save slot screen. Here you can start or continue games in three separate slots, each with an inventory panel so you can quickly see your progress.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Quick Thinker Update
notes.notes:
New saves started in "Quick Thinker" mode now have a six hour overall completion timer rather than individual puzzle timers.

This timer is pitched as a challenge to new players who think they're fast at solving puzzles, not a speed run target (which would be much lower). Enjoy!

notes.title: Minor Update: Spelinng Misstakes, timely achievement awards, long-lasting titles
notes.notes:
Fixed a couple of small spelling mistakes and missing spaces.

Achievements should now unlock as you achieve them rather than at the end of your play session

Level titles remain present for a little longer to allow you to read them.

notes.title: Update: Fix for "Landslide" being rather easier than intended!
Update: Fix for people with awkward monitor aspects, like my wife.
notes.notes: The puzzle "8 BIT SOFTWARE IS SUPERIOR" should now look less janky on 16:10 monitors.

notes.title: BUG FIX: Achievements!
notes.notes:
While setting up the GEMIMA demo, I accidentally managed to make it so that ONLY the demo would report achievements rather than NOT the demo.

Sigh.

It is unfortunately not possible to backdate ALL achievements you may have missed, but most of them will now unlock as soon as you collect a gem / push a rock / visit the credit screen etc if you had already reached the threshold for the achievement

ALSO:

The Purple Key Room has been updated to be more appropriate to the puzzles that preceded it. You will need to revisit that room to collect newly added gems if you had already got that far.

The LANDSLIDE puzzle has been updated to be fairer and more straightforward. If by some miracle you had already solved it, you will need to revisit that room to collect the gems needed to complete the game.

Apologies for any inconvenience!

notes.title: Update 7 : Reorganisation!
notes.notes:
After much soul-searching I decided that some of the puzzles required for completion on the main spine of the game would be better placed elsewhere. This shouldn't adversely affect anyone's progress, but let me know if I'm wrong!

Also added some missing entries to the end credits.

notes.title: Minor Update 5: My Wife Keeps Finding Shortcuts
notes.notes: This time it's BRIDGEWORK that she's managed to short-circuit. But not any more!

notes.title: Minor Update 5: Fixed a too-easy puzzle
notes.notes: My long-suffering wife found a sneaky too-easy solution to CRATE NORTH ROAD that has now been been ruthlessly expunged. Count yourself lucky if you sneaked through the same way...

notes.title: Minor Update 4: Added some thanks to the credits!
notes.notes: Wanted to thank the people who have helped playtest and provide feedback!

notes.title: Minor Update 3: Added another teachy-puzzle
notes.notes: DIAMONDS IN THE ROUGH is another puzzle you encounter before being explicitly forced to use the necessary tools. No more!

notes.title: Minor Update: Fix for requiring a game technique before it has been introduced.
notes.notes: Some levels got shuffled around during the design process, and I've realised that one puzzle required a technique that had not yet been introduced. This update tweaks the affected puzzle so that it can be completed without that technique, but doesn't otherwise meaningfully affect the puzzle.

notes.title: Minor Update: Bug fixes + extra flavour text
notes.notes: A tiny update to fix text not respawning correctly after an undo, and to add a little more chat between Gemima and Jules.
